evidence: Reference is a committed static baseline: solution/solve.sh is the template's two-line copy (mkdir -p /app; cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/) with no build, download or generation step; solution/app files are tracked in git at HEAD and their SHA256 match the frozen snapshot and raw-evidence-index matching_source_files (server.js f5d5801a..., app.js fd8df974..., seed_data.json b256f85e..., solve.sh f7c17a01...). solution/app/seed/seed_data.json is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json. Only time source for graded rules is the seed clock: server.js:32-33 CLOCK = String(seed.clock) ('2026-05-12T11:00:00Z', matching integration.md:7), used for new message 'at' (server.js:417), versions (438), transcript 'Generated' (516) and retention sweep CLOCK_MS - Date.parse(r.at) (143); server.js has no Date.now/new Date/Math.random. Seeding is deterministic: seedDatabase guarded by settings 'seeded' (server.js:94), messages inserted after a stable Array.sort by seed 'at' (111; V8 sort is stable so ties keep seed order), seq is AUTOINCREMENT in that fixed order, read_up_to mapped via seq, and new ids are counter-based 'K-'+n from next_id = max seed number + 1 (nextSeedNumber/newMessageId), not random. Remaining randomness is non-graded: per-user scrypt salt (server.js:98) and session token (301) are opaque secrets; client idempotency key crypto.randomUUID (app.js:7) only dedupes resends and never surfaces a pinned value. No boot-time fetch: index.html loads only /styles.css and /app.js, app.js fetch() calls are same-origin API calls, dependencies express@5.1.0/better-sqlite3@12.4.1 are exact pins preinstalled in both images. Counterexample probes: a broken reference using Date.now() for message times would move graded transcript/retention figures - not present here; a conforming alternative app that generates random message ids would not be penalised by this row since it concerns the reference only. Not a runtime measurement of a full configured judge run; static source inspection plus the indexed scripted golden restart observation.
